channel.title: Mr. Bones
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Mr. Bones" - A skeleton that makes puns, and slays in the name of the Christian God.

item.title: Re: Mr. Bones
item.content:encoded:
I don't think this idea is Greenlight ready yet though I think you could get it there if you keep working on it.

Central Narrative: Mr. Bones is the living skeleton of a deceased European knight who existed during the Crusades, researchers believing him to have taken part in the Fifth Crusade.(1217–1221)
Mr. Bones, at first glance, acts courteous and is willing to partake in interviews and conversations in general without complications. His conversations usually consist of his faith in God and his bone puns, which is repeated on a daily basis.

Seems interesting, I think you could have some fun ideas with this.

Once his War Horn(SCP-XXXX-C) is sounded however, he will immediately become violent, summoning his Sword(SCP-XXXX-A) and Shield(SCP-XXXX-B) from thin air and attack anyone he comes into contact with until the effects wear off or is subdued.

If memories serves it's recommended not to use SCPs that have a 'rage state' in which they go berserk and attack people because it's a bit of a cliche. This also seems to fall into the trap of being a 'thing that kills you' which is an anomaly that doesn't do much interesting beyond killing people.

+ show block
– hide block

So in conclusion this idea feels incomplete maybe? You start with a cool idea about a skeleton blessed with holy power, but than you don't really do anything with it, the story ends up being mostly just a monster who attacks and kills people. You don't tie the idea of him being a crusader into the story except a vague description of him attacking 'unholy' people.

Additional Notes: Their will be several logs will follow interviews with Mr. Bones. This interviews will go in more depth look into the "Berserker state."

The Berserk State is the least interesting idea here (and doesn't link back to the Holy Skeleton concept very well) but it's the part that gets the most focus.

In summery, I really don't think this idea is ready but I would not abandon it entirely, just try reworking it and giving Mr. Bones more stuff to do besides just attacking people.

item.title: Re: Mr. Bones
item.content:encoded:
I think you have a good character here. A super religious skeleton full of bone puns makes for an interesting premise (and I think we always need more light-hearted SCPs on the main site). My main problem is that that’s where you seem to be ending it. You haven’t brought up what you’ll be talking about in the interviews, you haven’t implied that you have any interesting plans for the “berserk mode”, and you’ve actively avoided giving this character any serious backstory.

I also have some more minor critiques: A sword with “kill” written on it seems a little redundant. I’d recommend something like a Bible verse instead. What’s with the war horn? Was it from the crusades? If so, why did they have a horn to make their soldiers go into a mindless rage? Is there a reason he needs to kill in self defense? After all, he is indestructible, so I’d personally find it more interesting if he wouldn’t even fight in self defense and instead just stood there and cracked jokes at the attacker. The same goes for the berserker horn, does he need to fight in defense of it?

Overall, I think this character could lead to an interesting article, but I still want to know what that article is.

item.title: Mr. Bones
item.content:encoded:
Mr. Bones
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Joke, (Somewhat) Serious

Elevator Pitch: A skeleton that makes puns. Also is blessed by the Christian God and fights in the name of His glory.

Central Narrative: Mr. Bones is the living skeleton of a deceased European knight who existed during the Crusades, researchers believing him to have taken part in the Fifth Crusade.(1217–1221)
Mr. Bones, at first glance, acts courteous and is willing to partake in interviews and conversations in general without complications. His conversations usually consist of his faith in God and his bone puns, which is repeated on a daily basis.

Once his War Horn(SCP-XXXX-C) is sounded however, he will immediately have a sudden change in personality. Mr. Bones will become more aggressive summoning his Sword(SCP-XXXX-A) and Shield(SCP-XXXX-B) from thin air. Depending on where they lie on his moral compass he will attack anyone he comes into contact with until the effects wear off or is subdued.

He has no recollection of his past, he only remembers he took part in the crusades, and was blessed by holy father
himself.

He was found in walking on of seclusive dirt path on route to Jerusalem.

+ show block
– hide block

SCP-XXXX-A: Looks like an seemingly normal European blade with the words "In gods name" in Latin etched on the sword blade vertically. This sword supposedly comes from the same material as the Spear of Longinus, the spear used to pierce the skin of Jesus Christ during his Crucifixion. This sword cannot be retrieved, as it can only be summoned by Mr. Bones' will when triggered into his berserker state.
It vanishes once he leaves the berserk state, or go unconscious.

SCP-XXXX-B: Stoney like shield, with 10 stone protruding from the shield, Which said to resemble the 10 contentment's. SCP-XXXX-B is invincible, just like Mr.Bones. Just like SCP-XXXX-A, SCP-XXXX-b can only be summoned in the berserker state.

SCP-XXXX-C: The War Horn: This item if blown into will cause no matter where bones is , will enter a berserker state. When he enters he will summon, SCP-XXXX-A, SCP-XXXX-B.

He will kill anyone who he can be considered unholy. If someone attacks him, he finds it funny and will crack jokes at the attacker until the attacker stops. The War horn is indestructible, and if attacked may trigger Mr. Bones into his berserker state.

Additional Notes: Their will be several logs will follow interviews with Mr. Bones. This interviews will go in more depth look into the "Berserker state." In the interviews in will realized that the berserker state is really a more of righteous state. Because Mr. Bones believe he is getting ride the world of impurity.
